rationale:
Independent judgment: APPROVE. The entire change under commit 2c8cded2 is one new administrative file, docs/ITEM4_STAGED_VALIDATION_DIRECTION_20261009.txt (15 insertions; confirmed by raw-commits-and-stats.txt and implementation.diff, byte-identical to the committed source/docs copy). It introduces no executable code, no scientific choice, no new input/image, and no spend. It requests a bounded process/direction opinion; it does not itself authorize implementation, provider admission or model spend, and says so explicitly.

Every factual claim in the document is corroborated by the supplied evidence and none overstates progress or waives a finding. (1) It states review9 is a genuine REVISE keeping U1/U2/U3 open and warns against reinterpreting REVISE as approval or mechanical failure; scientific-review9.json verdict is REVISE with all three findings open. (2) It credits only the specific closures the reviewer made - the nnUNetDatasetBlosc2 .keys() defect (now set(dataset.identifiers)) and a synthetic CPU native run - and labels GPU/production/efficacy as not established; NATIVE_VERIFIED.json confirms exit 0 but scope 'CPU generated fixtures ... no benchmark or efficacy' with gpu_verified/production_main_verified/scientific_approval/patient_data all false, so no efficacy claim is made from the 0.063 exploratory Dice. (3) It describes the base 893-file/7.2GB composed-volume readback with 99/49/0 overlap and that coverage inventory still lacks proof; SOURCE_VERIFIED.json verifies only base inventory b84b5f87 and SPEC13 line 24 concedes U1 open. (4) It preserves all 51 fits/seven preparations/40 FULL and the unconditional zscore/histeq holds; execution.plan.json retains those exact held rows and SPEC13 line 40 keeps the unconditional refusal.

On the fixed categories there is nothing unresolved: no code/spec mismatch (no code changed; the doc matches SPEC13/review9); no metric/statistic issue (synthetic metrics correctly flagged exploratory, no efficacy asserted); no privacy/secret issue (patient_data/patient_analysis false; no credentials; frozen-99 development only with prior exposure disclosed, so no test-set/leakage); no budget issue (caps $75/$1200/$1275 unchanged; the proposed scoped run-call cap26 is a call ceiling not dollars; the doc states no new/outside-cap money is requested and defers any paid execution to the ordinary gates); and no execution-authority/provenance defect (U1 confinement/provenance remains open and is not waived; the doc keeps execution, validation and spending gates intact).

The one potentially contentious element - proposing a further author14/review10 pair even though review9's rationale notes the three-cycle allowance is exhausted at the seventh cycle - falls squarely within the operator's standing written delegation (OVERNIGHT_AUTONOMY_OPERATOR_DECISION and STANDING_AUTONOMY_CHARTER): Claude may approve one-use exceptions to review-round/attempt limits for an approved backlog item, and only money requires the operator. No money is requested and no dollar cap is touched, so this consultation stays inside delegated authority. The document also correctly declines to simply suppress a finding to fit an all-findings-empty approval contract, instead asking for an equivalent or stronger staging check - preserving the scientific findings. analysis_entrypoint is null because no analysis-driver selection is involved in this documentation-only change. Findings are therefore empty and the verdict is APPROVE.
